evidence_scope: Metadata planner and complete external-mode inventory only; no formal resolved input, FE mesh, assembled matrix, factor, PDE, accuracy qualification, or memory admission.

source_and_recipe.candidate_recipe: In-memory overrides from the accepted P2 resolved configuration: wavelength 0.7 nm, target spacing 0.5 nm, boundary-fitted mesh, dynamic propagating-mode inventory, p6/p4 degrees 6/4, MPI size 1.

row_formula_and_p2_control.status: derived integer topology formulas cross-checked against accepted P2 runtime row inventories; candidate is not a generated FE space
row_formula_and_p2_control.periodic_domain_assumption: Structured hexahedra with x/y Floquet-periodic identification and open z boundaries.
row_formula_and_p2_control.interpretation: Periodic MPC identifies duplicate opposite-side edge and face unknowns. Both p6 outer-solve and p4 coarse-factor spaces statically eliminate per-cell interior unknowns and retain periodic skeleton plus port variables. Full original A6 action, explicit residual, and local reconstruction still perform cell-interior work. Port-mode variables are counted separately from mesh-field rows.

p2_control.p4_matrix_nnz_semantics: owned-row getRow stored entries, not factor fill NNZ

p4_backend_raw_info.negative_code_semantics: -54415 is a raw INFOG code at one-based keys 3, 9, 20, and 29; unit/semantic decoding is unknown and it is not a derived negative NNZ

p2_control.p4_MUMPS_factor_fill_and_allocated_bytes: exact factor-fill NNZ decoding and byte conversion remain unknown; raw backend INFOG/RINFOG fields are preserved separately

krylov_vector_payload_scenario.model: Assume approximately 65 complex128 arrays for FGMRES32, each sized at the p6 retained mesh-plus-port vector length.
krylov_vector_payload_scenario.scope_note: Payload arithmetic for the stated array-count and vector-length assumptions only. It is not observed allocation or RSS and excludes concurrent copies, matrices, preconditioner/factor, allocator, JIT, and process overhead.

p2_buffer_inventory_and_conditional_scal.overlap_rule: These categories overlap; do not sum them or treat them as RSS. Inventory deduplicates ndarray Python object IDs and nbytes, not shared backing allocations.
p2_buffer_inventory_and_conditional_scal.unknown_shapes: No saved component shape breakdown is available. Hlocal and global Hp/Hhat have possible mode-squared dimensions; their exact contribution is unknown.

cell_payload_if_every_byte_were_mode_ind.interpretation: Illustrative cell-only scaling assumption; actual cell payload contains port-related arrays, so this is not an upper bound or prediction.

port_cache_if_every_byte_scaled_linearly.interpretation: Illustrative all-linear mode scenario only; mixed and cell-by-mode terms are unpartitioned.

port_cache_if_every_byte_scaled_quadrati.interpretation: Sensitivity extreme only, not an upper bound. Only an unknown subset may be mode-squared; a per-cell mode-squared term would also carry the cell ratio.

backend_reported_p4_capacity_if_scaled_l.interpretation: Conditional linear-per-cell sensitivity only; not a measurement, lower bound, forecast, exact factor NNZ, or capacity qualification.

conditional_examples_not_forecasts.mixed_component_model: B_R48 = 25.768*B_cell_constant + 8.212*B_global_mode_linear + 67.438*B_global_mode_squared + 1737.720*B_cell_mode_squared; component baselines are unknown and these groups must be disjoint before summation.

one_dense_mode_square_complex128_array.interpretation: One hypothetical M-by-M complex128 array only; not evidence that a particular Hlocal/Hp/Hhat object has this exact shape or that arrays are independently allocated.

stored_matrix_nnz_if_p2_nnz_per_cell_wer.assumption: P2 stored input-matrix NNZ per cell stays unchanged; 24 bytes per entry is complex128 value plus int64 index, excluding row pointers and other storage.
stored_matrix_nnz_if_p2_nnz_per_cell_wer.interpretation: Conditional arithmetic only; not a lower bound, stored candidate matrix, factor estimate, or memory prediction.
